---
title: "Mixed hook-numbered and native items"
---

Native items (markdown image/table with a Quarto crossref id) and hook-numbered items
(`oq_numbering()`) in one document; `officequarto.crossref.auto-number` (see `_quarto.yml`) makes
both use the same `SEQ` sequence. Quarto notation works for both kinds.

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(officequarto)
oq_numbering()
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-hook
#| fig-cap: "HOOK-FIG"
#| echo: false
plot(1:3)
```

![NATIVE-FIG](../../../../template/plot.png){#fig-nat}

| a | b |
|---|---|
| 1 | 2 |
